entries.title: Puka risk prompts St. Brown/Kittle reallocation; Grok questions received
entries.question: Can we replace Puka's uncertain role and use the budget to improve the whole candidate without relying on Noel's unverified forward role?
entries.why_it_matters: The largest salary slot deteriorated in practice, while SF confirmed receiver absences; a whole-lineup adjustment can resolve one risk while introducing another.

St. Brown has 37 catches in five games, including eight then six in the last two. Kittle caught five in each of the last two; neither log provides a forward route guarantee.
Godwin Friday FP; Egbuka OUT; Mayfield FP all three days but questionable. Keenan FP and Warren OUT preserve a valid countercase to moving off Keenan.

entries.interpretation: Replace Puka with St. Brown and Keenan with Kittle. This is a Codex candidate informed by Claude and Grok, not a shared or jointly endorsed final. Kittle adoption follows current source checks; decline the full CMC/Noel financing package without a supported Noel role.
alternatives: Keep Keenan with St. Brown: $49,100 and $900 remaining; retains Colts involvement with Warren out.
Chase $8,100 directly for Puka gives $49,400 and $600 left, before any other change; not a fully investigated second candidate.
